profile.name: Abdulrahman Alsaadi
profile.pitch: Robotic systems from CAD to flight test.
profile.sub: I design, simulate, build and test robots: mechanical design and FEA, embedded control, ROS 2, and vision-guided autonomy.
profile.aboutTitle: The machine and the code that drives it
profile.summary: Mechatronics engineer and CSWP-certified mechanical designer. I take robotic systems from CAD, analysis and simulation through prototyping, assembly and physical testing, covering mechanical design, embedded control, software integration and iterative redesign.

points: Independently delivered 13 engineer-evaluated robotics projects across mechanical design, analysis, embedded control, computer vision, AI and robot interfaces; published the repositories on GitHub.
Redesigned a robotic-arm joint bracket with an integrated bearing housing and ran SolidWorks Simulation FEA (ABS, 100 N per edge).
Calculated static payload torque for a 3-DOF arm, selected servos for a 1 kg payload, and designed a complete 5-DOF arm assembly in SolidWorks.
Programmed Arduino/ESP32 pick-and-place applications and built Python/OpenCV and database-backed robot-control interfaces.

certifications.title: Certified SOLIDWORKS Design Professional, Mechanical Design (CSWP)

projects.title: WD Drone: TEKNOFEST 2026
projects.tagline: Autonomous rotary-wing UAV for the TEKNOFEST rotary-wing category
projects.role: Founding team member, simulation and systems integration (team of six)
projects.summary: A rotary-wing UAV built by a six-member team across mechanical, avionics, software and computer vision. I built the Gazebo/ArduPilot SITL environment, integrated the companion computer and flight controller, developed the target detection, and contributed to mechanical design and structural FEA.
features: Custom Gazebo/ArduPilot SITL for waypoint survey, target approach, payload delivery and RTL
Raspberry Pi 5, Camera Module 3 and Cube Orange integrated through MAVLink/pymavlink
OpenCV colour and geometric target detection at about 30 FPS
Velocity corrections generated from target-centre offsets
Autonomous waypoint flight with AUTO/GUIDED/RTL transitions
projects.architecture: The Pi 5 captures frames from the Camera Module 3 and runs OpenCV detection. Target-centre offsets become velocity corrections that pymavlink sends to the Cube Orange flight controller. Every mission stage was rehearsed in SITL before physical flight.
projects.results: Five flight-test sessions at about 3–10 m altitude covered autonomous flight, target detection and payload release. Structural FEA on the 5 mm carbon-fibre arm plates and 3 mm central-body plates under an 8 kg static load gave 24.9 MPa peak von Mises stress and a calculated factor of safety of 31.1.

projects.title: 3-DOF SCARA Robotic Arm
projects.tagline: Designed, printed, programmed and tested as a graduation project
projects.summary: A 3-DOF SCARA arm with 492.5 mm reach, a vertical Z-axis and a servo gripper. I handled mechanical design, manufacturing, electronics, firmware and system integration on my own.
features: Two-stage GT2 belt/gear transmission with NEMA 17 steppers and DRV8825 drivers
DFM applied to print orientation, supports, tolerances and bearing fits
ESP32 firmware in C++: forward and inverse kinematics, homing, motion limits, gripper control
Engineering drawings, BOM and manufacturing-ready CAD
Integrated with a mobile robot and conveyor over a three-node MQTT network
projects.architecture: Joint torque calculations guided motor selection. Links were topology-optimized, printed in PLA+ and post-processed with sanding, drilling, reaming, heat-set inserts and tapping. An ESP32 runs the kinematics and stepper control and talks to the mobile robot and conveyor over MQTT.
projects.results: Topology optimization cut link mass by about 80% while keeping the mounting and load-bearing regions. The revised links were manufactured and tested, the arm held a 100 g payload at full extension, and the three-node system demonstrated autonomous box transfer and shelving.

projects.title: myCobot 280 ROS 2 Simulation
projects.summary: A 6-DOF myCobot 280 configured and simulated with ROS 2 Humble on Ubuntu 22.04, using URDF/Xacro, RViz, Gazebo and ros2_control.
features: ROS 2 topics, publishers/subscribers, parameters, actions and launch files
